headline: All 14 crew rescued after Indian ship sinks off Yemen coast
summary: The MSV Faize Noore Oliya capsized after being hit by a projectile; 13 Indian crew and one other were saved.
script: All fourteen crew members have been safely rescued after an Indian ship sank off the coast of Yemen. Thirteen of them are Indian nationals. Officials condemned the attack and called for safe passage for commercial shipping in the region.
imageAlt: The MSV Faize Noore Oliya, an Indian-flagged vessel, seen at sea.
imageAltTwo: A file image of ships at a Yemeni port, illustrating the region's busy shipping lanes.
